```sql
WITH base AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT pv.product_id,
           pv.id               AS variant_id,
           ol.order_id,
           ol.quantity,
           ol.line_total_cents
      FROM orders o
      JOIN order_lines ol      ON ol.order_id = o.id
      JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.id = ol.variant_id::uuid
     WHERE o.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
       AND o.created_at >= %(from)s
       AND o.created_at <  %(to)s
       AND o.status IN ('paid', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered')
),
by_order AS (
    SELECT product_id,
           order_id,
           sum(quantity)         AS qty,
           sum(line_total_cents) AS rev
      FROM base
     GROUP BY product_id, order_id
),
by_product AS (
    SELECT product_id,
           count(*)::bigint AS order_count,
           sum(qty)::bigint AS quantity,
           sum(rev)         AS revenue_cents
      FROM by_order
     GROUP BY product_id
),
by_variant AS (
    SELECT product_id,
           count(*)::bigint AS variant_count
      FROM (SELECT DISTINCT product_id, variant_id FROM base) d
     GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT p.id,
       p.sku,
       p.name,
       p.brand,
       p.currency,
       bp.order_count,
       bp.quantity,
       bp.revenue_cents,
       bv.variant_count
  FROM by_product bp
  JOIN by_variant bv ON bv.product_id = bp.product_id
  JOIN products p    ON p.id = bp.product_id
 ORDER BY bp.quantity DESC, bp.revenue_cents DESC
 LIMIT %(limit)s
```

De brede rijen (113 bytes) die eerst op schijf werden gesorteerd voor `count(DISTINCT)` zijn vervangen door smalle hash-aggregaties per (product, order) en per (product, variant). Daardoor verdwijnen de externe sort en de temp-I/O. De kolomtypes blijven gelijk: `quantity` is nog bigint en `revenue_cents` nog numeric. De ORDER BY is ongewijzigd.
